The weighted port throughput calculation was successfully implemented and verified with a perfect reward score.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.76 across one trial with zero exceptions. The pytest suite in test_output.py passed all tests in 0.37 seconds using version 8.4.1. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check the judge's lower reward score (0.76) to identify potential stylistic or edge-case improvements despite the functional success.
